scope: Official frontend instructions for self-managed site widget access-token delivery
documentedContract: Initialize a Wix client with site authentication and site host, supplying the application ID.
In the custom element constructor assign the client's getAccessTokenInjector() result to this.accessTokenListener.
Use the client's fetchWithAuth() to pass the access token to the backend.
officialExampleClientInitialization: Module scope before custom element class definition
publishedStudioHostInspection: getAccessTokenFunction obtains an app ID from wixTagManager.getAppId and returns an app-instance getter only for a string ID. The tag manager identifies document.currentScript by object identity among embedded nodes associated with appInfo.id; absent identity returns an Error. Current rollback script was classic async and carried no data attributes. Inspection did not invoke the token getter or establish listener invocation.

nativeExtensionReadback.source: Authenticated Wix component GET and native UI, 2026-11-01

observations: The documented frontend section does not specify additional scopes for this token injection. This does not establish why the native runtime failed or prove a permission grant.
